statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-58016: g_dbus_node_info_new_for_xml() in gio/gdbusintrospection.c mishandles parser state when a node element is nested inside a method, signal, property or arg element of malformed D-Bus introspection XML, which can cause an integer underflow and out-of-bounds access (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/work_items/3932, https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/merge_requests/5156). Debian fixed it for trixie in glib2.0 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-58016). The DHI Debian 13 repository publishes six glib2.0 builds for amd64 and arm64: three rebuilds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u3 and three rebuilds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5. The changelog shipped in libglib2.0-0t64 of each 2.84.4-3~deb13u5 rebuild includes the 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 entry that lists CVE-2026-58016 and its patch; the 2.84.4-3~deb13u3 rebuilds predate it and do not list it. The range ends at the first rebuild of 2.84.4-3~deb13u5, the lowest published build that carries the fix.
